data.summary_en: HaMo (Harness-Model) couples fast non-parametric experience accumulation with slow parametric adaptation: distilling trajectories into strategy-level experience-cards; experience-conditioned continual learning trains models to understand-ground-execute strategies; retrieval-coverage-based selection picks trajectories for parameter updates; outperforms harness-only and model-only adaptation in in-domain and cross-domain transfer, improving retention and adaptation.
